10378|4fa5b9c3.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|4fa5b9c3.text: Where can I send you today $c?

1070|bd6c9aff.name: Deputy Feldon
1070|bd6c9aff.text: You'll find the town of Lakeshire yonder, across the bridge. But you'll not find it a peaceful place. If you're here for adventure, lad, then mark me--you've found it!

11068|327fd53e.name: Betty Quin
11068|327fd53e.text: I'm afraid I have nothing to teach to someone with your experience. But you haven't reached the end of the road yet. Speak to Lucan Cordell, behind the counter there. He'll guide you through the next phase of your journey.

11096|904d1c22.name: Randal Worth
11096|904d1c22.text: There's nothing I can teach you, other than maybe a better eye for color and detail. Talk to Simon Tanner over there; he knows a lot of advanced techniques for working with leather.

11116|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Abeqwa
11116|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

11860|ae16ea2b.name: Maggran Earthbinder
11860|ae16ea2b.text: I am afraid that I am no longer gentle or humble. Age and countless battles have hardened my skin and soul. Perhaps that is why Cairne assigned me to Sun Rock Retreat... the gentle winds and warm sun does ease the pain.

11861|2ff59fb5.name: Mor'rogal
11861|2ff59fb5.text:
Stonetalon Mountain has many perilous caves through out this region.  Exploring these caves can hold many adventures for those willing to risk life for glory.

$C, perhaps you seek riches that only following your heart and soul can garnish.

11865|7022eed4.name: Buliwyf Stonehand
11865|7022eed4.text: Ye want to be trained in the use of a weapon, do ye?  Well don't stand there slack-jawed, speak up laddie!

11867|3f5ede7c.name: Woo Ping
11867|3f5ede7c.text: Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?

11901|c5ceacbe.name: Andruk
11901|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

12736|e3f9a765.name: Je'neu Sancrea
12736|e3f9a765.text: The elements speak to us, $c.  They share knowledge that we must learn, and they share secrets that must be kept.

13084|554a4659.name: Bixi Wobblebonk
13084|554a4659.text: Well hi there!  Are you here to learn the proper technique of a new weapon?

1317|c3ea1f53.name: Lucan Cordell
1317|c3ea1f53.text: You seem confident. Surely you wouldn't mind a test of your skills?

1318|0624ab70.name: Jessara Cordell
1318|0624ab70.text: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

1318|23d8b931.name: Jessara Cordell
1318|23d8b931.text: I sell only the finest arcane gear, made by the crafters and mages here in the city of Stormwind.

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

1572|04178a2e.name: Thorgrum Borrelson
1572|04178a2e.text: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

1681|d4740e3c.name: Brock Stoneseeker
1681|d4740e3c.text: The best miner has a firm grip on his pick, a stout heart in his chest, and thick, black dust in his hair.

1976|37e215b2.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|37e215b2.text: Which class trainer are you looking for?

1976|9c8811bb.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|9c8811bb.text: Thorfin Stoneshield came to us all the way from Ironforge to bring us his expertise in hunting.  If you don't mind breathing the smoke filled air of the Dwarven District then you'll find him at his house in the northeast area of the district.

1976|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Patroller
1976|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

2327|2957a3a0.name: Shaina Fuller
2327|2957a3a0.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2457|2237a3b1.name: John Burnside
2457|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

256734|edaae191.name: Daniel Stitchsong
256734|edaae191.text: Hello there! I've got the finest leathers this side of Stormwind. Interested?

257597|32ab8342.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
257597|32ab8342.text: Out of the hottest fire comes the strongest steel.

258098|1605f087.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
258098|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

258098|8fca8484.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
258098|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

268047|53fff4bc.name: Theramore Emissary
268047|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

268925|17da1992.name: Night Elf Courier
268925|17da1992.text: The night elf is motionless, with multiple wounds and discoloration emblematic of suffering from poison.

274781|affb13bf.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|affb13bf.text:
If yer of need of an Inn, The Stonefire Inn is where ye should be.  Ye'll find it just to the left of the entrance to Ironforge if ye be coming, or to the right if ye be going.  

Oh, and if yer going that way, then tell them to have a tankard ready for me.

274781|ce6a7b9d.name: Iron Kingsguard
274781|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

2851|c5ceacbe.name: Urda
2851|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3142|99ae9589.name: Orgnil Soulscar
3142|99ae9589.text: Hail.  Be brief, for we both have much to do.

342|b92dcd04.name: Martie Jainrose
342|b92dcd04.text: Hail, PROPHOCY!  Welcome to my humble garden.  The weather has been perfect lately.  Let us hope it holds steady for a ripe harvest.

344|d18fd3a5.name: Magistrate Solomon
344|d18fd3a5.text: Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

3518|ed056522.name: Thomas Miller
3518|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3539|8259246a.name: Ott
3539|8259246a.text:
My blades don't glisten, glitter, or gleam, and they'll sing no epic songs about my creations when I'm gone. 

One thing you can be sure of though is that my weapons will cut down all the knights in Stormwind before losing their honed edge.

381|50146e32.name: Dockmaster Baren
381|50146e32.text: Well met, $C.  If you're here for business, then get yourself a brew and we'll have ourselves a talk.

382|04802d87.name: Marshal Marris
382|04802d87.text: I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

415|fca64b70.name: Verner Osgood
415|fca64b70.text: Hey buddy, do you think you could give me a hand with something?  I'm really in dire straits here...

4312|c5ceacbe.name: Tharm
4312|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

523|d6469a91.name: Thor
523|d6469a91.text: Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

5515|08830bac.name: Einris Brightspear
5515|08830bac.text: Through rigorous retraining I have had to break many students of all they had previously learned so that I might teach them anew.  The service I offer becomes increasingly difficult to perform each time it is done.  It is for that reason that it becomes increasingly expensive with each retraining.  Do you desire that I break you of the talents you have learned?

5515|4a5716a3.name: Einris Brightspear
5515|4a5716a3.text: Look at the wisdom and knowledge of the beast, and you will see yourself. Observe as the owl does, learn cleverness from the sabercat, embody the mighty spirit of the wolf.

5516|4a5716a3.name: Ulfir Ironbeard
5516|4a5716a3.text: Look at the wisdom and knowledge of the beast, and you will see yourself. Observe as the owl does, learn cleverness from the sabercat, embody the mighty spirit of the wolf.

5519|3d4f7092.name: Billibub Cogspinner
5519|3d4f7092.text: If you insert tab A into slot B then of course it's going to go BOOM! Here, let me show you what I have and then you can ask Lilliam about how to put it together so it doesn't blow up.

5564|568f7020.name: Simon Tanner
5564|568f7020.text: Hmm, I guess I can take on another student. Well, don't just stand there. Tell me what you're looking to learn.

5565|877c4b1d.name: Jillian Tanner
5565|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

5595|3804779b.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|3804779b.text: Which class trainer might ye be looking for?

5595|ac68ec99.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ac68ec99.text: Yer looking to learn how to use a new weapon are ye?  Well, ye should be talking to Bixi or Buliwyf over at the Timberline Arms weapon shop then lad.  They know their weapons from axes to... uh... zweihanders.

5595|cbc8f1aa.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|cbc8f1aa.text: Och! Ye seek training in the way of the warrior, do ye?  Kelstrum Stonebreaker will put ye through yer paces!  Just march yerself over to the Hall of Arms east of the gates of Ironforge.

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

5595|e6c8b4c9.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|e6c8b4c9.text: The seers of the old ways, aye I know 'em. The waters of The Forlorn Cavern are where ye can find Eldrun Stormbreaker, $C trainer fer the kin o' the elements.

5943|a28d29e1.name: Rawrk
5943|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

656|eb6991e6.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
656|eb6991e6.text:
There were thieves everywhere! 

It was horrible.  The cave came down on us.  I think the mining company is all dead, including my brother, the Foreman.

6727|4a0923b3.name: Innkeeper Brianna
6727|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

6727|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Brianna
6727|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

6740|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

68|37e215b2.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|37e215b2.text: Which class trainer are you looking for?

68|4e0ec384.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|4e0ec384.text: Which profession trainer are you looking for?

68|819b99eb.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|819b99eb.text: Lucan Cordell has a small shop on the canal by the Stockade. I am sure he will be able to teach you the art of enchanting.

68|94dfc58d.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|94dfc58d.text:
A $C is it?  Well, then you will want to speak with Thorfin Stoneshield over in the Dwarven District.  

Oh, and you be sure to tell him that if I step in his pet's business one more time, he's going to be training other hunters from behind bars in the Stockade!

68|9e9bec9c.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|9e9bec9c.text: What do you need directions to?

68|c66ddc75.name: Stormwind City Guard
68|c66ddc75.text: Want to learn leatherworking, eh? Simon Tanner would be able to teach you. He can be found in Old Town at the Protective Hide.

6928|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Grosk
6928|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

7731|7161de72.name: Innkeeper Jayka
7731|7161de72.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

8962|0a5060df.name: Hilary
8962|0a5060df.text: I think my necklace fell in the lake.  My daddy got it for me, and he's gonna be mad now.

8965|5a359b3f.name: Shawn
8965|5a359b3f.text: Hello there mister... do you have a little time that you could help us out?  Please?

9087|e4fd33dd.name: Bashana Runetotem
9087|e4fd33dd.text: Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

102-complete.name: Captain Danuvin
102-complete.text: Well done, $N.  With valiant adventurers such as yourself fighting alongside The People's Militia, Westfall just might return to the prosperous breadbasket it once was.  Please accept this in recognition of your tireless efforts.
102-complete.title: Patrolling Westfall

102-progress.name: Captain Danuvin
102-progress.text: Have you collected 8 paws from those treacherous Gnolls yet?
102-progress.title: Patrolling Westfall

1087-accept.name: Braelyn Firehand
1087-accept.text:
You cannot imagine the hatred I possess for this wretched land. The ilk of Cenarius and the kaldorei druids at the peak employ their pathetic powers to stifle the flow of magic, even so far south of their pathetic holdings... their beloved forests.

Would that I could return to Jaedenar and exult in the flow of magic, but my master will not allow me to return until my work is done.

I have no doubt you love the night elves and their allies as little as I. Aid me, and both our ends might be satisfied.
1087-accept.title: Cenarius' Legacy

1087-complete.name: Braelyn Firehand
1087-complete.text:
Already I can feel it... yes... power so sweet... the rushing flood. The kaldorei are foolish to spurn the gifts of this world, to reject the coursing of magic as it flows singing through your veins.

What a pale mockery life is without its burning embrace!
1087-complete.title: Cenarius' Legacy

1087-progress.name: Braelyn Firehand
1087-progress.text: Here, channeling magic is like drawing water from a well with a bucket full of holes.
1087-progress.title: Cenarius' Legacy

1088-accept.name: Braelyn Firehand
1088-accept.text:
They thought that they could halt the flow of magic. They were mistaken. They thought that they could hide Ordanus, but I will have his head!

Magic grants me true sight. Yes... there he is. A crossroads... At the top of a great tree in Ashenvale Forest. A name... Raynewood. One of the eldest sons of the forest god. They spirited him away from the peak before I could find him, but his time runs short.

Bring it to me and I will share with you a mighty gift.
1088-accept.title: Ordanus

1097-accept.name: Verner Osgood
1097-accept.text:
There's a dwarven weaponsmith in Stormwind, Grimand Elmore, who sent word that he needs help with a delivery.  I believe he wants a package sent to his homeland in the north.

You have a sturdy pair on you!  So if you're interested in some legwork then speak with Grimand.  We could use you down here, but we must also keep our ties strong with the dwarves.

You can find Grimand Elmore at the weapon shop in the Dwarven District of Stormwind, in the northeast section of town.
1097-accept.title: Elmore's Task

1097-complete.name: Grimand Elmore
1097-complete.text: You're here to help with my delivery?  Very good!
1097-complete.title: Elmore's Task

1130-complete.name: Melor Stonehoof
1130-complete.text:
So, $N, you have come.  Now, are you prepared to journey through distant lands?

If so, young $c, then listen on...
1130-complete.title: Melor Sends Word

1131-accept.name: Melor Stonehoof
1131-accept.text:
At times we hunt for food.  At times we hunt for honor.  And at times we hunt to earn the Earthmother's teachings.

But the hunt I now set upon you is none of these things.  It is to slay a creature outside the Earthmother's blessing.

The hyena Steelsnap roams the Thousand Needles, south of the Barrens.  He is a tyrant, attracting other hyenas to him and spreading fear and bloodshed among more peaceful beasts.

Find Steelsnap, $N.  Find him, and defeat him.
1131-accept.title: Steelsnap

116-accept.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-accept.text:
I find myself in quite a pinch here, $N.  The bottles are close to running dry.  The latest booze shipment is long overdue.  The orc invasion has been hell.

Perhaps you can go to work for me?

I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
116-accept.title: Dry Times

118-accept.name: Verner Osgood
118-accept.text:
I've been using so much iron keeping the Stormwind Guards outfitted, I don't have enough to supply the stable's horses with shoes!

Take this note to Blacksmith Argus in Goldshire.  It explains to him my problem and requests a shipment of horseshoes.
118-accept.title: The Price of Shoes

12-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
12-complete.text: Well done, $N.  My scout witnessed your valiant acts.  You are proving yourself quite well so far.
12-complete.title: The People's Militia

120-accept.name: Magistrate Solomon
120-accept.text:
These are trying times, $c.  The township is under constant siege.  Without reinforcements, we will certainly face defeat.  The message I now entrust to you is of utmost importance.  Get this report to General Marcus Jonathan of Stormwind immediately.  Once your delivery is made, return to me at once with any news, be it good or bad. 

Now make haste!
120-accept.title: Messenger to Stormwind

120-complete.name: General Marcus Jonathan
120-complete.text:
At ease, $c.

Magistrate Solomon is a noble leader.  His words carry great weight with me.  I shall seek the counsel of the King and make the situation clear to him.  Assure the good judge that he has the Stormwind Army's support.  Reinforcements will be sent as soon as word is given from His Majesty.
120-complete.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-accept.name: General Marcus Jonathan
121-accept.text:
While I wait for a response from the King I want you to carry this letter to Magistrate Solomon. 

Dismissed, $c!
121-accept.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-complete.text:
Thank you for your time, $c.  For your service to Lakeshire and Stormwind I reward you with these coins.

Now if you'll excuse me, I find this correspondence somewhat of a mystery.  Something is amiss in our Kingdom.  I fear this is the beginning of conflict, not the end.
121-complete.title: Messenger to Stormwind

121-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-progress.text: Did the General send news?  Are reinforcements on the way?
121-progress.title: Messenger to Stormwind

125-accept.name: Foreman Oslow
125-accept.text:
I could really use a hand here, $N.  With the town under siege, it's been hard to get supplies.  My tools were being delivered from Goldshire by wagon but the bridge was blown out.  We put the tools in a boat but the orcs hit it with a catapult.  Just my luck, my toolbox sank right to the bottom of the lake.

Retrieve my toolbox, $N, and I'll make it worth your while.
125-accept.title: The Lost Tools

125-complete.name: Foreman Oslow
125-complete.text: Excellent recovery, $N!  I never thought I'd see these tools again.
125-complete.title: The Lost Tools

125-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
125-progress.text: Were you able to find my tools?
125-progress.title: The Lost Tools

127-accept.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-accept.text:
Lake Everstill is famous for its spotted sunfish.  There's always demand for them...and I'm running low!

Bring me a batch of 10 and I'll barter well for them.  If you can't fish yourself, then...maybe you can get them off the murlocs!
127-accept.title: Selling Fish

127-complete.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-complete.text: Pleasure doin' business with you, matey!
127-complete.title: Selling Fish

127-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
127-progress.text: You have some sunfish for me, eh?
127-progress.title: Selling Fish

128-accept.name: Guard Howe
128-accept.text:
The Blackrock Clan must be destroyed. The Enemy has invaded our lands. These mountains fall under the sovereign right of the King of Stormwind. Our sources tell us that the leaders of each unit within the Clan are known as Champions. You'll find them in their encampment to the north, just west of the road to the Burning Steppes.

Magistrate Solomon wants these foul brutes dead. Slay 15 Blackrock Champions and return to me.
128-accept.title: Blackrock Bounty

128-complete.name: Guard Howe
128-complete.text: I see you have fought valiantly against the Blackrock Clan, $C.  Your service to our township is great indeed.
128-complete.title: Blackrock Bounty

129-accept.name: Darcy
129-accept.text:
Can you do me a favor?  I've prepared a lunch for Guard Parker, but he's out on patrol...he's a big, strong Stormwind guard who can defend himself, but it's much too dangerous out there for a townsperson like me.

So if you deliver his lunch for me, then come back here and I'll give you a free lunch!  Parker patrols the stretch of road leading to Duskwood.
129-accept.title: A Free Lunch

129-complete.name: Guard Parker
129-complete.text: Thanks, I could really use the meal.  Guarding Lakeshire from the orcs and gnolls is tough work!
129-complete.title: A Free Lunch

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

13-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
13-accept.text:
A band of vicious Defias Pillagers has been seen plundering the Gold Coast Quarry, Moonbrook and the Alexston Farmstead.  The People's Militia will not stand for such behavior.  Dispatch immediately, $N, and make the Light's presence known in Westfall.

The Gold Coast Quarry is near the shore, to the West of the tower.  As the next step of your training, I want you to kill 15 of those foul Defias Pillagers and 15 Defias Looters.
13-accept.title: The People's Militia

13-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
13-complete.text: Your worth to The People's Militia has been validated by your brave acts thus far.
13-complete.title: The People's Militia

130-accept.name: Guard Parker
130-accept.text:
Before you go back to Darcy, can you bring her some flowers for me?  You can get them at the herbalist shop back in Lakeshire, at the west end of town.

But when you get the flowers...don't tell the herbalist, Martie, whom they're from, or whom they're for...
130-accept.title: Visit the Herbalist

130-complete.name: Martie Jainrose
130-complete.text:
You need a bouquet of flowers?  You haven't been in town very long...have you already found for yourself a sweetheart here?

I know I shouldn't pry, but it's nice to see that love is in the air... especially in dangerous times like these.
130-complete.title: Visit the Herbalist

131-accept.name: Martie Jainrose
131-accept.text: Here is your bouquet.  I chose Daffodils for you.  They're my favorite!
131-accept.title: Delivering Daffodils

131-complete.name: Darcy
131-complete.text:
Oh, those are lovely!  I can't wait to put them in some water!

But...these are Martie's favorite flowers.  Parker didn't have you go to that jealous vixen for this bouquet, did he?  You didn't tell her who they were for, did you?  If you did, then it wouldn't surprise me if she poisoned them.

Oh, but it's not your fault.  Thank you, and here's your meal.
131-complete.title: Delivering Daffodils

131-progress.name: Darcy
131-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
131-progress.title: Delivering Daffodils

132-accept.name: Wiley the Black
132-accept.text:
What I am about to tell you could cost me my life.  The Defias gang is up to something big.  Last I heard they were working in conjunction with various gnolls, kobolds and even goblins.

Take this note to Stoutmantle.  It explains as much as I know on the subject.
132-accept.title: The Defias Brotherhood

14-accept.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
14-accept.text: Some Defias have eluded us.  My most trusted scout reports that these Defias have been looting and pillaging the countryside, all the way into Southern Westfall.  We believe they are hiding out in the Dagger Hills, plotting their next move.   Slay the wretches in the name of The People's Militia.
14-accept.title: The People's Militia

14-complete.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
14-complete.text: When I left the tainted lands of Lordaeron I returned to a grim state of affairs here in my homeland.  But there is hope for Westfall yet.  As proven by your valor in battle, it is obvious to me that you serve our cause with honor.  It is with great pride that I induct thee into The People's Militia.  May the Light shine upon you.
14-complete.title: The People's Militia

143-accept.name: Magistrate Solomon
143-accept.text:
Something odd is afoot with the Stormwind Army.  They should have been here in force by now.  Time is a luxury we don't have, however.  I will not stand by and watch the people of Lakeshire give their lives without trying to enlist more help.  I've heard word of a people's militia forming in Westfall.

Take this plea to their leader, Gryan Stoutmantle.  Perhaps Stoutmantle's men can lend some support here until the King sends reserves.
143-accept.title: Messenger to Westfall

150-accept.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-accept.text:
Murlocs are becoming a problem.  Larger groups of the fishmen are dropping anchor along the shores of Lake Everstill and fishing up a storm!  We need them gone before they eat all the fish in the lake!

Hunt murlocs!  Bring me eight of their fins and I might have something for you...
150-accept.title: Murloc Poachers

150-complete.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-complete.text:
Well done, $N.  I hope you didn't have too much trouble with those murlocs.

It's strange seeing them so far from the sea.  I wonder if they're here because they're running from something...
150-complete.title: Murloc Poachers

150-progress.name: Dockmaster Baren
150-progress.text: Do you have those fins?  Hurry, we need those murlocs driven from the lake!
150-progress.title: Murloc Poachers

167-complete.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
167-complete.text: My suspicions were correct.  My poor brother.... Well, thank you for bringing some conclusion to this mystery, even if the conclusion was grim.
167-complete.title: Oh Brother...

167-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
167-progress.text: Did you find any sign of my brother?  Is there any hope after all this time?
167-progress.title: Oh Brother...

168-complete.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
168-complete.text: Thank you for collecting these, $N.  Your efforts will help bring peace to the dead in the wake of this tragedy.  I will see to it that the families are notified.
168-complete.title: Collecting Memories

168-progress.name: Wilder Thistlenettle
168-progress.text: Were you able to retrieve any of my old co-worker's Miners' Union Cards?
168-progress.title: Collecting Memories

169-accept.name: Unknown
169-accept.text:
Wanted! Gath'Ilzogg, Leader of the Blackrock attacks on Stonewatch Keep and raids against the township of Lakeshire. 

Gath'Ilzogg is extremely dangerous.  He is reportedly holed up in the recently conquered keep plotting the Blackrock clan's further crimes against humanity.  The orc infestation must be quelled at all costs.  A gracious reward will be given to whatever brave soul can deliver the head of Gath'Ilzogg to Magistrate Solomon.
169-accept.title: WANTED: Gath'Ilzogg

169-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
169-complete.text: Fantastic work, $N!  Gath'Ilzogg led those brutes into battle, killing many innocent humans.  Vindication is ours.  This is the first step in reclaiming the keep for the kingdom of Stormwind!
169-complete.title: WANTED: Gath'Ilzogg

178-accept.name: Unknown
178-accept.text:
<You hear a disembodied voice...>

Do not be alarmed.  I am Theocritus, High Mage of Tower Azora in Elwynn Forest.  The pendant you are holding is a method of communication between the Shadowhide Gnolls and their master, Morganth.

Through months of research, I believe I too can communicate through these pendants.  If you can hear this message, then my spell was a success.

Bring me this pendant and I will reward you for the service.
178-accept.title: Theocritus' Retrieval

180-accept.name: Unknown
180-accept.text:
Wanted: Lieutenant Fangore

Known leader of the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan, working under the enemy of the Township and Kingdom, Morganth.  By mandate of Magistrate Solomon, this vile betrayer of Stormwind is wanted dead.  Show his paw to the Magistrate as proof of his death.
180-accept.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

180-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-complete.text: So the evil Lieutenant Fangore is dead?  Good riddance to that foul creature.  You are very brave, $c.  The Township of Lakeshire thanks you for your aid.
180-complete.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

180-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-progress.text: What news do you bring before the Court?
180-progress.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

20-accept.name: Marshal Marris
20-accept.text:
The Blackrock orcs have travelled from the Burning Steppes and claimed Stonewatch Keep to the north.  From there they maraud the areas north of Lakeshire and keep its citizens in town, penned like cattle.

Help rid Lakeshire of this menace.  Kill these Blackrock orcs and bring me ten of their Battleworn Axes as proof.

And although Blackrocks threaten us from the north, we've received reports of more in the southeastern pocket of Redridge.  If you find any there, then they too should be hunted.
20-accept.title: Blackrock Menace

20-complete.name: Marshal Marris
20-complete.text: That makes for a lot fewer orcs to worry about, thanks.
20-complete.title: Blackrock Menace

20-progress.name: Marshal Marris
20-progress.text: Have you been slaying orcs, $N?  If so, then show me...
20-progress.title: Blackrock Menace

2040-complete.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-complete.text: Well done, $N. Thanks to you, Gnomeregan is one step closer to its day of liberation!
2040-complete.title: Underground Assault

2040-progress.name: Shoni the Shilent
2040-progress.text: Have you found the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket, $N?
2040-progress.title: Underground Assault

219-complete.name: Marshal Marris
219-complete.text: You have served the Kingdom well, $C.  Thank you for assisting Corporal Keeshan with his escape from those dreaded Blackrock Orcs.  You shall be rewarded for your brave acts this day.
219-complete.title: Missing In Action

237-complete.name: Mountaineer Gravelgaw
237-complete.text:
You accomplished your mission well, $r.  The King himself would be proud.

The reinforcements promised to us never showed, however.  Apparently the Alliance front is a sea of crimson from the blood of our fallen brethren.  The news of the losses leaves a bitter taste in one's mouth.  But we must not let their deaths go for naught.  We must rally in these grim times and bring glory back to the Alliance.

Speak with Mountaineer Wallbang for reassignment.  You're needed now more than ever.
237-complete.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

244-accept.name: Guard Parker
244-accept.text:
Hail, $c.  I am charged to patrol this stretch of road.  Although the road is safe for now, I've seen gnoll encampments to the north and east of here.

Lakeshire must know of the gathering gnoll force!  Report to Deputy Feldon in Lakeshire and tell him of the gnolls.  Do this, and I'm sure Feldon will offer you a scout's wage.

Feldon's usually inspecting the area south of the bridge to Lakeshire.
244-accept.title: Encroaching Gnolls

244-complete.name: Deputy Feldon
244-complete.text:
There are Redridge gnolls that close to Elwynn??  They may be poised to advance into our homeland.  Soon the people of Lakeshire may not be the only humans under siege!

Here is your pay, though you bring us dire news.  And it comes at a bad time, for we are ill equipped to deal with it.
244-complete.title: Encroaching Gnolls

246-accept.name: Deputy Feldon
246-accept.text:
We don't have men to spare, but something must be done about those gnolls you reported to me.

Scout southern Redridge for gnolls.  Harry them, kill those you can and report back to me with a count of their numbers and an assessment of the threat they present.  You may find those gnolls camped all along the southern road of Redridge.

Do this for the Stormwind Army, $N, and you will be rewarded.
246-accept.title: Assessing the Threat

246-complete.name: Deputy Feldon
246-complete.text:
<Deputy Feldon listens to your report...>

There's a sizable force of gnolls encamped there, and from what you tell me they are tough ones.  It must not have been easy for you to gather this intelligence.

Here you are, $N.  We are grateful for your aid.

And if you haven't already done so, speak with Marshal Marris and Magistrate Solomon within Lakeshire.  Our situation grows ever more desperate - those two will have need of you I'm sure.
246-complete.title: Assessing the Threat

263-accept.name: Mountaineer Wallbang
263-accept.text:
The Mountaineers tell me you are quite brave and capable, $N.  We need a $r like you around here.  The Trogg problem isn't getting any better.  The reserves have been called to the front and we're all alone out here.  But now that we have a seasoned $c here, let's see what you can do.

Go out and kill 10 Stonesplinter $C and 10 Stonesplinter Bonesnappers.  Let's see if you live up to your reputation, Trogg-Slayer.
263-accept.title: In Defense of the King's Lands

2928-accept.name: Shoni the Shilent
2928-accept.text:
It's terrible, $N. We are not going to have enough parts to get our fleet of gyrodrillmatic excavationators to Dun Morogh.

What we need are spare parts, $N. What better place to get the spare parts for our vehicles than Gnomeregan? I hear that bots and mechs roam around that place like cattle on an open range.

What I need you to do is go to Gnomeregan and tear apart those robots. Bring me back their robot guts. Two dozen should be sufficient.
2928-accept.title: Gyrodrillmatic Excavationators

34-accept.name: Martie Jainrose
34-accept.text:
Once again my garden was trampled and pillaged.  And I know the brute who is doing it.  It's that forsaken boar, the one Marshal Marris has taken to calling Bellygrub.

I won't be able to re-plant the daffodils until next season now.  Ruined!  All ruined by that one menacing boar.  Put an end to that pest!  Show me his tusk and I'd be happy to reward you.  He seems to spend his time foraging in the field southwest of Lakeshire but occasionally he roams over here and into my garden.
34-accept.title: An Unwelcome Guest

34-complete.name: Martie Jainrose
34-complete.text: Finally the menace is laid to rest!  Thank you, $N, you have done me a great service.  The garden shall be in full bloom this season!
34-complete.title: An Unwelcome Guest

34-progress.name: Martie Jainrose
34-progress.text: Is Bellygrub still at it or were you able to rid Lakeshire of the pest once and for all?
34-progress.title: An Unwelcome Guest

343-accept.name: Brother Kristoff
343-accept.text:
I'm giving a speech on the Fortitude of the Spirit, and I'd like to recite passages from a particular book on metallurgy - "The Stresses of Iron."  A copy of this book should be in the Royal Library, within Stormwind Keep.  Can you retrieve it for me?  If so, then may the blessings of the Light be with you!

The Royal Library is very large, but the head librarian, Milton Sheaf, knows each shelf like it was his own son.  Speak to him, he'll retrieve the book for you.
343-accept.title: Speaking of Fortitude

3741-accept.name: Shawn
3741-accept.text:
My friend Hilary lost her necklace, and we can't find it.  We've been fishing all day right here, and we looked around here already.  The only thing I can think of is that it fell into the lake.  Our parents don't want us to swim in the lake... my mom says there's some mean things underwater, but you look like you aren't scared of mean things.

Could you find it for her, please?
3741-accept.title: Hilary's Necklace

3741-complete.name: Hilary
3741-complete.text: Thank you for finding my necklace mister $c... you are very kind!  My kitty thanks you too - isn't that right Effsee?
3741-complete.title: Hilary's Necklace

3741-progress.name: Hilary
3741-progress.text: Hi.  I miss my necklace.  My daddy got it for me.  Daddy says that there are monsters in the lake.  Did you beat up any monsters?
3741-progress.title: Hilary's Necklace

386-accept.name: Guard Berton
386-accept.text:
Targorr the Dread served under Gath'Ilzogg as supreme Executioner.  His methods were ruthless, even by filthy orc standards.  Men who fought bravely to defend the Kingdom were tortured on his whim.  Now he is being held in the Stormwind Stockade, sentenced to die.  Yet something is amiss.  One of the bureaucratic nobles put a hold on his execution.  I am sure foul play is in the works.

Put an end to Targorr the Dread, $N.  Travel to The Stockade and behead him before trickery is upon us.
386-accept.title: What Comes Around...

5062-complete.name: Magatha Grimtotem
5062-complete.text:
Good, you have gathered the essential amount of Incendia agave. This rare herb found only in Thousand Needles will help light the dormant sacred fire of life.

<Magatha begins to enchant the Incendia agave.>
5062-complete.title: Sacred Fire

5062-progress.name: Magatha Grimtotem
5062-progress.text:
So, Motega Firemain sends word of Arikara...well now that is grave news.

<Magatha looks around.>

Arikara is a deadly creature born only to seek vengeance against those who have committed heinous acts.

<Magatha smiles.>
5062-progress.title: Sacred Fire

5088-accept.name: Magatha Grimtotem
5088-accept.text:
Take this refined and purified Incendia Powder to Thousand Needles and toss it on the sacred fire of life. It is located in the Darkcloud Pinnacle on an isolated needle where they bury their dead.

The enchantment that I have weaved into the Incendia powder will summon Arikara to you, $N.

I fear she may be stalking Cairne Bloodhoof; too much Tauren lore has changed, and I fear this has angered Arikara. Move quickly before all is lost, $c!
5088-accept.title: Arikara

5881-accept.name: Maggran Earthbinder
5881-accept.text:
The Horde does well keeping our troops fresh... since the Great War we have been prosperous here in Kalimdor.

I need you to do me a favor, I have a lad by the name of Grish Longrunner protecting the Great Lift in the southern barrens. Give him this letter; the letter will let him know that I have a reserve warrior coming to relieve him of duty so that he can visit his family. He requested this sometime ago and he would be happy to hear the news.
5881-accept.title: Calling in the Reserves

6282-complete.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6282-complete.text: This is most excellent news! Tell me again how you cast fear into the cold hearts of those vile harpies. The Bloodfuries have been dealt a serious blow!
6282-complete.title: Harpies Threaten

6283-accept.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6283-accept.text:
Limiting the number of Bloodfury Harpies will not be enough. The only true cure for their disease would be to slay their leader, Bloodfury Ripper!

She is all but a queen to those filthy creatures. Slay her and their numbers will surely diminish.

Go back into the Charred Vale and you will find her along the western hills. She will not be easy to vanquish, but the reward will be great.
6283-accept.title: Bloodfury Bloodline

6301-accept.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-accept.text:
Industrial greed and continuous war have wrecked the lands of Stonetalon. Only the blessings of the Earthmother can cure such injury.

$N, I will require you to seek a special seed, the Gaea seed. They are only found here in Stonetalon Mountain, north of Sun Rock Retreat at Mirkfallon Lake, near the water's edge.

Once you bring me the seeds I will imbue them with shamanistic power to speed their growth.
6301-accept.title: Cycle of Rebirth

6301-complete.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-complete.text:
Ah, $N, you have the Gaea seeds. Watch and see how the blessing of the Earthmother can cause even these small kernels of life to bloom and flourish.

<Tammra begins to chant.>
6301-complete.title: Cycle of Rebirth

6301-progress.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-progress.text: The continuous destruction caused by war and those that seek a profit from lumber pains me deeply. To aid the cycle of rebirth and replenish the lands, I need Gaea seeds. Do you have them, $c?
6301-progress.title: Cycle of Rebirth

6381-accept.name: Tammra Windfield
6381-accept.text:
As you have seen, $c, though the land is in pain, the cycle of life is a powerful thing. Now we must do our part help it along. You must plant these seeds at the center of the destruction, to the west, in the Charred Vale. Beware, for harpies and angry fire elementals still plague the scarred land.

$N, take these enchanted Gaea seeds and plant them in fertile mounds of soil. The cycle of life must go on!
6381-accept.title: New Life

6393-accept.name: Tsunaman
6393-accept.text:
The Tribunal of the Tides has sent me to wage war on the fire elementals here in Stonetalon Mountain. Neptulon the Tidehunter, Lord of all water elementals, has taken a personal interest in seeing our fiery cousins extinguished.

$N, you can help me gain favor with the Tribunal by destroying the fire elementals in Charred Vale. When destroyed, the fire elementals leave Incendrites. Return these to me and be rewarded.
6393-accept.title: Elemental War

6393-complete.name: Tsunaman
6393-complete.text: The water spirits within me bubble with the excitement. $N, you have given me a glorious victory to report to the Tribunal of the Tides.
6393-complete.title: Elemental War

6393-progress.name: Tsunaman
6393-progress.text: The Tribunal of the Tides grows impatient. They seek to end this war that has raged across all dimensions for eons. My brethren are anxious to hear news of the glorious victory over the hated fire elementals. Have you the Incendrites that I require?
6393-progress.title: Elemental War

6421-accept.name: Mor'rogal
6421-accept.text:
Something is amiss here in Stonetalon. Can you feel the tension in the air, $N?

Southeast of here lies a deep cave in Boulderslide Ravine. The kobolds there are frantically mining a rare crystal called Resonite. I need you to bring back some ore samples so that I can understand what's happening in that cave.  I also need you to investigate the depth of that cave.

Go young $c, it's imperative I know what evil lurks under these mountains.
6421-accept.title: Boulderslide Ravine

65-complete.name: Wiley the Black
65-complete.text: So, Stoutmantle sent you?  Well, I owe him.
65-complete.title: The Defias Brotherhood

6565-complete.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6565-complete.text:
Very good!! Thank you, $N. We may not have stopped the Twilight's Hammer completely, but at least you have staved off another of their plans to return the Old Gods to power.

Who knows what other plans they have manifesting, but we can rest easy for now.
6565-complete.title: Allegiance to the Old Gods

806-complete.name: Orgnil Soulscar
806-complete.text:
Aha!  You got him!

You do your clan proud, $N.  And because of you, Durotar is free of one more agent of evil.
806-complete.title: Dark Storms

806-progress.name: Orgnil Soulscar
806-progress.text: Did you find Fizzle, $N?  He, and rest of the Burning Blade, must be scoured from our lands!
806-progress.title: Dark Storms

828-accept.name: Orgnil Soulscar
828-accept.text:
One of our Shamans, Margoz, knows more of the Burning Blade's corruption.  He speaks of a cave called Skull Rock in the mountains - just outside Orgrimmar! - that shelters a large band of Burning Blade cultists.

Before you go to Skull Rock speak with Margoz.  He is wise and his council is valued.

He is camped to the northeast, between the coast and Drygulch Ravine.

Follow his advice, but whatever Margoz says, $N, I still want you to crush those cultists!
828-accept.title: Margoz

834-accept.name: Rezlak
834-accept.text:
I'm Rezlak, one of Gazlowe's boys. Boss sent me to help the orcs here in Durotar. Things'd been going good except for the caravans. Can't manage to keep them safe! Makes my job a little harder, you know?

The last shipment--they promised it'd get through!--was snatched by the Dustwind harpies of...where was it...Razorwind Canyon?

I gotta have those supplies or I'll never get anything done! Follow the big canyon to the south, you'll find the ravine cut right into the west and east sides of the walls.
834-accept.title: Winds in the Desert

834-complete.name: Rezlak
834-complete.text: Hey, now isn't that just the thing! You've got our supplies back for us. That's great. I'll be able to get back to work just as soon as I can find someone to haul these sacks for me.
834-complete.title: Winds in the Desert

834-progress.name: Rezlak
834-progress.text: I'm great at what I do, don't get me wrong, but this is ridiculous! What am I supposed to do, build sand castles?
834-progress.title: Winds in the Desert

835-accept.name: Rezlak
835-accept.text:
Gazlowe told me once, "Rezlak. There's one thing you need to know in life, and that's if you want something done well, do it yourself."

I can't deal with losing all our caravans, so I'm just going to take matters into my own hands. Drygulch Ravine lies through the eastern part of Razorwind Canyon. If we kill all the harpies there, the routes will be safe.

Of course, there was one other thing that Gazlowe taught me, and that's "You can get anything done for a price." So, going to help me out, $N?
835-accept.title: Securing the Lines

86576-progress.name: Mor'rogal
86576-progress.text: I have important matters to consider, $c. Be quick.
86576-progress.title: Bloodfury Trinkets

89-accept.name: Foreman Oslow
89-accept.text:
During the last orc invasion we were forced to smelt our iron down to make bullets, swords and armor.  We sent word to Stormwind for a new shipment of materials but a band of Redridge gnolls hijacked the caravan and ran off into the hills behind Lakeshire.

Now we're coming up short on supplies to get this bridge rebuilt.  If you can bring me 5 iron pikes and 5 iron rivets, $N, I'll make sure you're rewarded. 

Now let's get to work!
89-accept.title: The Everstill Bridge

89-complete.name: Foreman Oslow
89-complete.text: Great work, $N.  These supplies will help the bridge effort immensely.  We'll get this beauty shored up in no time.
89-complete.title: The Everstill Bridge

89-progress.name: Foreman Oslow
89-progress.text: This bridge isn't going to build itself!  Now where are those iron pikes and iron rivets?
89-progress.title: The Everstill Bridge

91-accept.name: Bailiff Conacher
91-accept.text:
An enemy of Stormwind has taken up residence in the eastern foothills of Redridge. This wicked villain uses the Arcane to spread terror and misery upon our town and our people. Under the name, Morganth, he conducts his evil business.

Morganth now controls the Shadowhide Gnoll Clan to perform his biddings. As stated by the Law of Lakeshire, aiding a criminal of the Kingdom is punishable by death.

These vile gnolls must be killed!

Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
91-accept.title: Solomon's Law

92-accept.name: Chef Breanna
92-accept.text:
Nothing would please me more than to make you some Redridge Goulash. But there's a slight problem. During the recent orc uprising I fed the entire brigade of Stormwind troops. My cupboard is now bare. But if you can provide me with the ingredients, I'd be happy to oblige.

Just bring me five pieces of Tough Condor Meat, five Great Goretusk Snouts and five helpings of Crisp Spider Meat.
92-accept.title: Redridge Goulash

94466-progress.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94466-progress.text: Aye, I've near all I need for the fire sapta, $N--just missin' the fire tar and the seer's pouch. The tar's carried by Tunnel Rat Geomancers in the kobold caves up north. The pouch ye'll need to wrest from a Stonesplinter seer in the southern hills. These ingredients are bound to flame, as all true saptas must be. Their elemental ties make our craft strong.
94466-progress.title: Call of Fire

94467-progress.name: Braldir Ashmantle
94467-progress.text:
The brazier stands about a third your height, with charred inscriptions along its smooth metal rails. The metal shows no signs of wear from the weather, and the bowl seated at the top of it feels cool to the touch. 

Blackrock Mountain looms in the distance, in clear view to honor from this sacred place.
94467-progress.title: Call of Fire

94468-progress.name: Bruegs Kindleborn
94468-progress.text: Aye, $N? What do ye have there?
94468-progress.title: Call of Fire

95664-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
95664-progress.text: Spirits honor you. Have you come to share with us?
95664-progress.title: Elder Knowledge

96243-accept.name: Eldrun Stormbreaker
96243-accept.text:
It's past time ye heeded the earth, brave $C. The elements already prickle in yer skin, but once ye speak with the stone, the ground itself'll set firm 'neath yer soles--and in yer soul.

Seek out Teo Hammerstorm, in Coldridge Valley. Ye'll find him within Anvilmar, a holdfast forged by hammer, fire, and will.
96243-accept.title: Call of Earth

96395-accept.name: Unknown
96395-accept.text:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395-accept.title: An Ancient Grudge

96395-complete.name: Unknown
96395-complete.text:
My... Thane... he... rests... yes... rest.

Thank... you...

I... rest...
96395-complete.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403-progress.name: Thom Filch
96403-progress.text: <Thom appears to absentmindedly rub his hands together as he looks at you.>
96403-progress.title: Important Heirlooms

97538-progress.name: Tah Winterhoof
97538-progress.text:
You have returned! Were you able to find the mirkweed plant pods in Mirkfallon Lake?

We tauren have used this plant pigment in our paints for generations, so any amount you manage to bring would be appreciated. Though there are many ways to get a red pigment, I find the mirkweed to give the richest and most vibrant hue of the methods I'm familiar with.
97538-progress.title: Pigments for Paints

97985-progress.name: Calder Gray
97985-progress.text: Oh, you've returned in one piece! Pity, if you hadn't your bones and what's left of your flesh would have made excellent fodder for my tinkering.
97985-progress.title: Thundering Hearts

98387-progress.name: Marshal Marris
98387-progress.text: Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.
98387-progress.title: Blackrock Blockade

98407-progress.name: Deputy Feldon
98407-progress.text: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
98407-progress.title: Show of Force

98423-progress.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
98423-progress.text: What have you brought from the depths, $c.
98423-progress.title: The Treaty of Understanding
